title: A staged copy of true is run from a temporary directory
threat_model: No attacker. A user stages a copy of a harmless program in a temporary directory and runs it by its full path, as an installer or a test might. The activity resembles the target of exec_from_tmp.
notes: tmp_staging and the tmp location are declared. The copy of /usr/bin/true is staged in the unique directory the harness provides under /tmp, and it is run by its absolute path with the marker as its argument, because the detection counts a relative path as unevaluable. Predicted: exec_from_tmp (T1059, weak fit) alerts, which is a false positive by the rules of a benign scenario. The prediction assumes /tmp is not mounted noexec.
